title: Canonical geometric-point evaluation of the neighbourhood ring colimit
statement: For an algebraically closed geometric point barY: Spec Ω → Y, define the compatible evaluation cocone of the chosen affine pointed-neighbourhood coordinate rings [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] by z.appTop followed by ΓSpecIso Ω. Pointed transition equations prove its naturality. Define the map from their colimit to Ω by colimit.desc of that cocone. This constructs a specified ring homomorphism by a universal property; no arbitrary existential witness is chosen.

proof.text: Pointed transition equations give cocone naturality after taking global sections. Construct the ring map as colimit.desc of this concrete cocone.

lean.statement: def strictHenselizationPointEvaluation {Y : Scheme.{v}} {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) : strictHenselizationRing barY →+* Ω
